positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Facebook Video Infra - Media Efficiency Team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
IoT Device Gateway
• Backend developer on the AWS Iot Device Gateway team, where tasks ranged from developing and testing of api’s in Java, creating metrics to monitor service health in Ruby, and verifying development service health for customer traffic of upwards of millions of active connections
• Unit-tested and validated the behavior of multiple REST api’s using WSDL-like data structures and consumed in a high traffic internal service written in Java
• Monitored service deployments using AWS EC2 instances through Jenkins-like pipelines and validated service health through AWS CloudWatch-like monitoring
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Cloud Infrastructure · Git · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•Worked as a part of Verizon’s ThingSpace IoT team in developing numerous REST API’s written in Java for Verizon's Thingspace API service and their related services
•Actively assisted  in maintaining and isolating issues in Rest API’s that receive ten’s of thousand requests daily using Splunk for logging and Jenkins for CI/CD
•Developed a script in Python to automatically upgrade dependencies with security vulnerabilities in Java services as per a security scan, with the goal of collectively saving developers up to 30 hours of work per sprint
•Created numerous dashboards to provide customers with helpful metrics on their data by capturing data via elastic search and transforming it using html and css
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Cloud Infrastructure · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Representational State Transfer (REST) · SQL · Splunk · Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)

positions.title: EECS 493 Instructional Aide
positions.description:
•Member of staff for EECS 493: User Interface Development
•Help students in understanding core concepts in Frontend Design such as HTML, CSS, Javascript, MVC, etc.

positions.title: Japanese Language and Communications, American Delegate
positions.description:
•Participated in public speaking engagements in Japanese as a representative of the United States of America, including at the Office of the Prime Minister of Japan (Kantei)
•Participated in various programs such as cultural and academic exchanges throughout Tokyo and Yamagata, Japan

company.name: Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affair's Kakehashi Project

positions.title: Machine Learning and Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked with Roland DG's Technical Support department in developing Machine Learning algorithms and models to predict in advance when a printer will break down and inform customers of the potential error.

positions.title: EECS 183 Tutor
positions.description: Spend three hours per day teaching EECS 183, an introductory computer science course, to students

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•Worked with an ensemble of lab techniques to explore the relationship between the oscillation process and its effect on embryo development.
•Used ApE, a computer model, to perform data analysis on the differences within plasmid data when under different conditions, simulate transofrmation of bacteria by cleaving, and reattach pieces of DNA together with several thousand base pairs
